summary: A trigger condition reading real party-slot state, and a second small quest marking the household complete once all four slots are filled

coordination.notes: The same small, grounded shape as companion-recruited-condition, one step further: recruit_island_person marks someone loyal, assign_island_companion (a distinct, existing, tested verb) puts her in one of the four real party slots (FactionWorld.party). PartySize reads that array directly -- how many of its four entries are non-empty -- not a proxy for it. A second quest, quest.the_household_forms, resolves once all four are filled, proven end to end through the real production/approach/talk/recruit/assign path for four separate produced women, not a synthetic fixture. Validator bounds at_least to 1-4 since the party has exactly four slots and anything higher could never be true -- the same reachability discipline the quest lane's stage-reachability check applied. Still not the companion-and-lead investigation system the authority describes; still no Betty, no geography, no invented identity.
